name: crypt-door-open
prompt: The iron door in the far wall now stands wide open on darkness beyond.
extra: The twelve heads on their poles keep their exact spacing, heights and angles; the torch and the carved wall are unchanged.

name: crypt-dim-door
prompt: Low on the side wall among the stone courses, the faint outline of a concealed door has become visible, a single weathered mark cut into it.
extra: The heads, the poles, the open iron door and the torchlight are all unchanged.

name: crypt-dark
prompt: The torch has gone out. The chamber is nearly black, the poles and heads only just suggested by the faintest edge light, everything else swallowed in darkness.
extra: Nothing has moved; only the light is gone.

name: guarded-room-sleepy
prompt: The lizard head embedded in the door has closed its eyes and slackened, plainly asleep.
extra: The door, its stains and banding, the cobwebs and the dust tracks are unchanged.

name: guarded-room-sleepy-open
prompt: The heavy door now stands open, swung inward on darkness beyond.
extra: The sleeping lizard head stays exactly where it is on the moving door.

name: guarded-room-alert-open
prompt: Combine the two reference images: the room and the wide-open door from the second reference, but with the lizard head alert and watchful as in the first reference, eyes open and fixed on the viewer.

name: dragon-lair-princess
prompt: A young woman in a pale gown now stands quietly at the edge of the empty scorched hollow, looking down into it.
extra: The hollow, the bones, the treasure and the shaft of light are exactly as they were.

name: pool-room-muddy
prompt: The drained basin has filled with thick brown mud, glossy and slumped, its surface pocked and cracking at the edges.
extra: The basin's outline, the walls, the torch and the arch are unchanged.

name: dreary-room-unlocked
prompt: The heavy stone lid set into the table's top has been unlocked and shifted a hand's breadth to one side, a dark crescent of opening showing beneath its edge.
extra: The table's height, position and proportions and the bare room around it are unchanged.

name: dreary-room-lid-lifted
prompt: The stone lid has been lifted clear and set down leaning against the table's foot; the circular recess in the table top is fully open and dark.
extra: The table and the room are otherwise unchanged.

name: cerberus-room-calm
prompt: The collared three-headed hound has lain down flat on the flagstones, all three heads resting on its paws, entirely docile and half asleep.
extra: The door, its banding, the gouges and the torchlight are unchanged.

name: formal-garden-unicorn
prompt: A white unicorn now stands on the gravel beside the fountain, head raised, quite still.
extra: The hedges, paths, fountain and the flat sourceless shadowless light are unchanged.

name: formal-garden-unicorn-fled
prompt: The unicorn has bolted: it is gone from the frame, leaving scuffed gravel and a scatter of disturbed stones where it stood.
extra: The hedges, paths, fountain and light are unchanged.

name: gazebo-princess-awake
prompt: The carved chest on the gazebo floor now stands open, its lid thrown back, and the cushioned bench beside it is rumpled as though someone has just risen from it.
extra: The white lattice, the boarded floor and the garden beyond are unchanged.

name: wizards-workshop-wizard
prompt: A tall gaunt wizard in a patched robe now stands at the near bench with his back three-quarters to the viewer, one hand raised over the glassware.
extra: Every bench, instrument and light source keeps its exact position.

name: depository-curtain-north
prompt: The far wall of the vault is now a flat sheet of cold white light from floor to ceiling, edge to edge, with no frame and no opening — a curtain of light, and the only light source in the room.
extra: The vault ribs, their spacing, and the flagged floor are unchanged.

name: depository-curtain-east
prompt: The curtain of light has moved: the far wall is now ordinary dressed stone, and instead the right-hand wall is the flat sheet of cold white light.
extra: The curtain itself renders exactly as before; only which wall carries it has changed.

name: depository-curtain-south
prompt: The curtain of light has moved again: the right-hand wall is now ordinary stone, and the wall behind the viewer's left shoulder glows, throwing the vault ribs into relief from behind.
extra: The curtain renders exactly as before.

name: depository-curtain-west
prompt: The curtain of light has moved once more and now fills the left-hand wall, floor to ceiling.
extra: The curtain renders exactly as before; the vault is otherwise identical.
